title: Container With Most Water
description: You are given an integer array `height` of length `n`. There are `n` vertical lines drawn such that the two endpoints of the `i-th` line are `(i, 0)` and `(i, height[i])`. Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water. Return the maximum amount of water a container can store.

hints.content: Start with the widest container using two pointers at the ends.
The area is limited by the shorter line: min(height[left], height[right]) * (right - left).
Always move the pointer pointing to the shorter vertical line inward.

solution.explanation:
Two pointers starting from both extremities. Move the pointer with the smaller height inward since moving the taller one cannot increase the area.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(1)
